| Qwen3.5 (new section) | 19 | 50 | 221 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (new section) | 4 | 4 | 22 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |

| DeepSeek-V4.1 (refreshed) | 9 | 19 | 83 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |

Model Deployment`, with an explicit `agentic-long-context-deployment` anchor. The generator itself is unchanged.
  - The hand-written `#### 5.2.3 Agentic Long-Context with HiCache DRAM Offload (H200 FP8, MTP)` (added in #35194) is removed. The explorer includes that lane (`qwen3.5-fp8-h200-sglang-agentic-hicache-mtp`) at its latest measured run. Nothing linked to the old anchor.
- **GLM-5.2 / DeepSeek-V4 / DeepSeek-V4.1.** Only the generated data files change; the page text is unchanged. Rendered commands change only for the overlaid lanes above, plus one derived variant:
  - **#3817** carries the DSV4 B300 Dynamo recipes from #3631, with disaggregated KV transfer over NIXL (`SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_NIXL_BACKEND=LIBFABRIC`) instead of Mooncake over AWS EFA. The EFA Mooncake setup step disappears from those deployments.

Same pipeline and rules as #42726. Each lane is rendered at the exact commit of the run that produced its dashboard data or, for an open PR, the run named by its authorized `/use` comment (the PR head when there is none). SA-only settings are removed (benchmark harness, cluster paths and caches, telemetry, InferenceX's synthetic speculative acceptance, which is disclosed per deployment). - **KV offload.** HiCache variants borrow flags from the closest verified HiCache launch of the same model on the same hardware (an absolute `--hicache-size` is only reused there). The Mooncake variant reuses the verified DeepSeek-V4 GB300 external-linker spec on every page, and is disabled where the image's SGLang build predates `--enable-unified-cache-external-linker`.
- **Derived Dynamo on an image without `ai-dynamo`.** Derived Dynamo variants use the `ai-dynamo` bundled in the image. `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.16-cu130` (the Qwen3.5 B200 NVFP4 and B300 single-node lanes, all submitted with the SGLang router) ships without it, so for those 10 deployments the derived Dynamo variant installs `ai-dynamo` 1.4.2 first. 1.4.x is the release line whose `[sglang]` extra pins `sglang==0.5.16`, and 1.4.2 is the wheel the verified Qwen3.5 GB200 Dynamo launch used.
- **Not mirrored.** `qwen3.5-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic` (H100 without MTP) has never produced dashboard data, so there is no run to pin it to.
- **Images.** Several nightly tags these runs used have since been pruned from Docker Hub; the page flags them and links the SGLang commit they were built from. - The Deployment-panel footer link appears on GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-V4.1 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, under the Playground link, and scrolls to the section without changing the Deployment selection in the URL hash. Qwen3.5's `#agentic-long-context-deployment` anchor sits directly above the explorer. Pages that use the Deployment panel without the prop (PaddleOCR-VL, Unlimited-OCR) still show no link.
- The component's decoder and KV-tier transform, run through Node, reproduce the Python-generated commands for all 2,328 combinations. Every KV-cache flag in a shown command exists in the SGLang commit of that deployment's image (188 image/flag pairs).

No serving or benchmark runs were performed for this PR; the numbers live in the linked SemiAnalysis runs. SGLang CI was not triggered.

-### 2.3 GB300 long-context serving with HiCache and MTP
-
-Use this single-GPU, aggregated TP1/EP1 configuration for long-context, multi-turn workloads on GB300. It combines the NVIDIA NVFP4 checkpoint's embedded MTP head, CPU DRAM KV offload through HiCache, and pinned-memory PLE embedding offload.
-
-This serving configuration comes from [InferenceX #3816](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3816). [Run 37714835620, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37714835620) passed concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 48 and 64 on commit `e67ca6fc9ecf4cd57f27654bda8a3e9059923820`. Its [matching GSM8K eval](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37714835620/job/113109083376) used real verification and scored 97.35% on 1,319 questions.
-
-The throughput sweep used InferenceX's simulated acceptance; the generated command uses normal MTP verification and does not claim those throughput numbers for production traffic.
-
-#### Prerequisites and memory budget
-
-- Use a Linux ARM64 GB300 host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and a driver compatible with the image's CUDA 13.0 runtime. See [Docker installation](/docs/get-started/install#method-3-using-docker).
-- Reserve one GB300 GPU. The recipe keeps TP, PP, DP and EP at 1.
-- Budget 224 GiB of CPU memory for the combined target/draft KV and Mamba HiCache host pool, plus approximately 48 GiB for the offloaded FP8 PLE table and additional headroom for checkpoint loading and host processes. `--hicache-size` sets the combined cache budget; it is separate from PLE weight offload. Keep sufficient free host memory for both.
-- The Docker command mounts your Hugging Face cache to retain downloaded model files across restarts. The image digest and both target/draft checkpoint revisions are pinned to the validated configuration.
-
-#### Generate the launch command
-
-In the [Deployment panel](#deployment), select **GB300 → NVFP4 (NVDA) → Low Latency → Single Node**, and leave **PLE Offload** at **Auto** or **On**. The matched cell includes all five serving environment variables and the full argument set, including ReplaySSM, HiCache and pinned PLE offload. Choose **Docker** to use the pinned image, or **Python** for a matching local installation. Changing PLE Offload to **Off** produces an unverified configuration.

-The Docker wrapper comes from the shared command builder and is adapted from the validated Slurm/Enroot launch; it has not been run separately on a GB300 host. Use the command generated by the panel rather than a separate static copy.
